notes: BENCH-3 corpus manifest — the source of truth for the default program set, categories,
and pinned LLVM-lane exit codes. run.py refuses to run (exit 2) if progs/*.rs and this
manifest disagree, and dies (exit 2) if the LLVM lane's observed exit differs from
expected_exit (detects a silent LLVM-side change, per roadmap BENCH-3).
Category membership determines which staged gate a program counts toward
expected_bridge is INFORMATIONAL (intent-to-treat status at commit time, x86_64,
dylib of 2026-07-02): an expected-INCOMPLETE row that flips to MATCH is a completeness
improvement (run.py prints a note); an expected-MATCH row that fails closed is a
candidate regression (the coverage ratchet catches it). Never edit expected_exit
Exit codes are the full-width u64 checksum of the whole computation folded mod 126
(contract section 6 collision caveat applies to every MATCH).

p3_gcd.note: euclid gcd over LCG pairs, div/rem-heavy

p4_matmul.note: 24x24 i64 matmul reps — the audited 9.7x auto-vectorization loss

p7_sieve.note: 1KB sieve of eratosthenes reps (contract names the matmul/sieve class G1b)

v2_memfill.note: memset-shaped whole-array byte fill, black_box'd probe

v3_popcount.note: byte-array popcount loop (proven width-32 popcnt in the bridge)

h1_vec_push_sum.note: Vec push 300k + 300 index-sum passes, exit without drop

h2_vec_grow.note: growth-heavy Vec to 6M elems, interleaved data-dependent reads

h3_box_leak.note: Vec<Box<u64>> deref-sum: bridge=llvm=76 after the scalar-collapsed-newtype read arm accepts a thin &Box<u64> pointee (*v[k] -> ((*_r).0).0: NonNull<u64>) — landed 2026-07-18

h4_vec_dropper.note: per-rep fresh Vec DROPPED in-loop (drop_in_place glue) — verified MATCH 2026-07-02

m1_call_chain.note: inlining-shaped f1->f2->f3->f4 chain, 30M iters (inlining gap, OPT-4)

b1_mispredict.note: data-dependent unpredictable branches, per-arm stores defeat if-conversion
